# Agent skills

One directory per skill, each containing a `SKILL.md`. A skill is a named,
repeatable investigation workflow the agent can invoke.

Format:

```markdown
---
name: skill-name
description: When to use this skill.
argument-hint: "[arg1] [arg2]"
---

Numbered steps, stated assumptions, and what to return.
```

Nothing here yet — skills follow the domain model.
